correctness.rationale: An all-parameter Laurent determinant calculation forces E=Q_C-qr/p; its coefficient is s(qr-p(Q_C-E)) with p,s>0. The Schur complement of the positive C pivot is [[alpha, sz],[s/z,beta]], so a flat band occurs exactly when alpha beta=s^2. The nonzero AC principal minor g alpha proves fiber rank exactly two. Schur-inertia distinguishes bottom/middle and compactness gives a gap for each fixed real potential/positive hopping tuple. Exact Laurent polynomial kernel and trigonometric-polynomial density give the two-cell translate-spanning result. SymPy verifier replays these identities and selected samples. No finite sample is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The fixed connected triangle-plus-bridge chain is a motivated minimal three-site model that lies immediately beyond the fully handled two-orbit exceptional-potential case of Sabri and Youssef. The theorem is a complete all-real-potential, all-positive-hopping classification rather than arbitrary point testing: its smooth irreducible quadric has two physical components, with the sign identifying either an isolated lowest or isolated middle flat band, together with a two-cell generator. Exact tuning and gap placement are naturally needed to design/localize flat states. The broad 2025 generic no-flat theorem does not provide this exact model-level information.
